sloka: अङ्गदं परिरक्षान्तौ मैन्दो द्विविद एव च।तस्य तस्थातुरभ्याशे परस्परदिदृक्षया ।। ६.७६.१५ ।।
transliteration: aṅgadaṁ parirakṣāntau maindo dvivida eva ca।tasya tasthāturabhyāśe parasparadidṛkṣayā ।। 6.76.15 ।।

translations.english: Both Mainda and Dwivida (maternal uncles of Angada) took position for the protection of one another facing the enemy.
